claim_summary: For all real a>4 and omega>=0, exp(-a*d(x,y))*cos(omega*d(x,y)) on real hyperbolic five-space is positive semidefinite precisely when omega^2 <= a^2-12/5-(2/5)*sqrt(5*a^4-20*a^2+16).
integrity: All identities are derived in RESULT.md and symbolically checked by the included script. Finite numerical quadratures corroborate but do not certify the universal theorem. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only curvature -1 real hyperbolic five-space, decay a>4 and real nonnegative modulation frequency. Spectral claims use the integrable spherical Fourier transform. Bibliographic priority beyond accessible sources has not been exhaustively checked.
title: A sharp oscillatory-Laplace admissibility threshold on five-dimensional hyperbolic space
